features.summary: This was _only a typo correction_ in the autoplay code, with no intended change to autoplay behavior.

features.label: Driftcontrol

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Get rid of collections.OrderedDict

features.summary: Driftcontrol was simplified by removing a dependency on Python’s collections.OrderedDict, relying on the regular dictionary behavior available in supported Python versions. This is an internal maintenance change with no visible browser feature impact.

features.label: Encrypted Media (EME / DRM)

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Part 5. Make KeySystemConfig/MediaKeySystemAccess use the new gfxVars.

features.summary: Encrypted Media Extensions (EME), the web platform used by DRM-protected playback, now uses Firefox’s shared graphics capability information when deciding which key systems and media configurations are available. This helps those decisions reflect the device’s actual media support.

features.label: Media Control / Session

patches.author: Sugarycandybar
patches.subject: Pick largest MediaMetadata artwork sizes first.

features.summary: Firefox now prefers the largest artwork images supplied through MediaMetadata, the web feature that provides a page’s media title and artwork to browser controls. This helps platform media controls show a sharper image when several sizes are available.

features.label: Media Source Extensions (MSE)

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Fix TimeUnit overflow when converting MSE duration to microseconds.

features.summary: The fix prevents Media Source Extensions (MSE)—the browser feature used by many streaming players—from overflowing when converting a media duration into fine-grained time units. This helps Firefox handle long or large duration values accurately.

features.label: Tools

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Teach GMP scripts to generate yml for Widevine artifacts used in CI.

features.summary: Firefox’s Widevine DRM build scripts can now generate the YAML files needed to use Widevine artifacts in continuous-integration testing. This improves automated checks for the protected-media component without changing what users see.

features.label: WebVTT / captions

patches.author: Sotaro Ikeda
patches.subject: Disable video overlay whlie video position is moving on Windows

features.summary: On Windows, Firefox now disables the video overlay while the video is moving on screen. This is intended to prevent visual positioning glitches during movement; it does not describe a change to caption formats or controls.
